method: Navigate each actual route once per language/theme, resize through ten formats, wait for stable layout. Observations are resize observations, not 600 cold starts or 600 full journeys.
coldHash: StudentDPA only, FR/EN light/dark at320/1440:8 cold observations after about:blank, initial HTML target plus actual heading/header geometry.
interactions: Four report-abuse groups language/theme: named radio group, arrows, draft resize320→844landscape→1440→320, Escape. Four ordinary internal legal-link/Back groups after checking destination is same-origin and allocated. No submit, mail activation or external navigation.
safety: GET local origin only; no service workers. Block all nonGET and third-party requests. No fixture API server needed: these route loaders only resolve locale; bind app SAAS_API_URL to a closed localhost port after contract check if own server is required. Never use real backend.
range: DPA document/contact links and StudentDPA PDF/Word: every nonempty text-node Range must be contained by link border; computed white-space/height/min-height, icon width and shrink recorded. Also inspect button viewport containment. 44px height expected on these four changed controls.
limits: No new zoom, physical virtual keyboard, Safari/WebKit, contrast measurement, production, legal certification, file download, email or real report submission. Preserve existing evidence rather than rerun unrelated unit suites.
processes: Browser starts only when explicit BASE_URL and LEGAL_AUDIT_GO=1 are passed after parent GO. Record child PID/startTicks for diagnosis. If own app required, record origin before use and verify /proc absence after cleanup, not just closed port. Never terminate parent-owned server.
